papers.title: Evaluation of a Partial Ban on Rx-Rebates in Germany.
papers.abstract: We investigate patients' price sensitivity for prescription (Rx) drugs with regards to patronizing online or brick-and-mortar pharmacies. In doing so, we exploit a policy change in Germany that prohibited online pharmacies from granting rebates to one part of the population, the members of the statutory health insurance scheme. This policy change created a natural experiment, allowing us to analyze its impact on the pharmaceutical market using Difference-in-Differences (DiD). Utilizing a novel dataset obtained from merchandize information systems, we find that the ban led to a shift in consumer behavior, increasing offline pharmacy Rx sales by 1.42%-1.67%. In a second step, we assess to what extent the policy change achieved its alleged goal of supporting brick-and-mortar pharmacies. Our findings indicate that pharmacies with low revenues, which are most exposed to market exit, saw only a minor increase in annual revenues of around € 1587. At the same time, pharmacies in the highest decile gained roughly four times that amount. This indicates that the policy change alone was insufficient to reverse the declining trend in pharmacy numbers in Germany. To strengthen the comprehensive supply of pharmaceuticals to the general population, additional reforms seem necessary.
papers.summary: 本研究利用德國禁止網路藥局對法定保險成員提供處方藥折扣的政策變化作為自然實驗，透過雙重差分法（DiD）分析患者價格敏感性與購藥行為。結果顯示，該禁令導致消費者行為轉變，實體藥局的處方藥銷售量增加了 1.42% 至 1.67%。然而，政策對最需要協助的低營收藥局幫助有限，其年收入僅小幅增加約 1,587 歐元，遠低於高營收藥局的增幅，顯示該政策未能有效扭轉實體藥局減少的趨勢。
papers.significance: 該文獻的意義在於揭示了市場監管政策對藥品產業鏈的實際分配效果，證明僅靠限制線上折扣並不足以挽救弱勢實體藥局。研究結果為政策制定者提供了重要依據，指出若要維護醫療資源的普及性，需超越單一的價格干預，尋求更全面的結構性改革方案。

papers.title: How Does the Ethical Environment Matter to Hospital Performance?
papers.abstract: This study investigates how hospital performance may be influenced by environmental ethics, measured by regional medical corruption cases. To address the endogeneity issue, we use corruption cases in non-medical sectors as instrumental variables for medical corruption in regions with hospital operations. Our analysis combines data on corruption investigations with hospital management and performance measures from the World Management Survey, covering more than 500 hospitals in China from 2014 to 2016. We found that a one-third increase in corruption cases in a region reduces management quality by 0.05 standard deviations, increases the complication rate by 3%, and increases the length of stay by 0.15 days. Subgroup analyses revealed that the negative effects of corruption are particularly pronounced for management quality in younger hospitals and for performance outcomes in older hospitals. Furthermore, we found that compared with corruption at the hospital-leader level, corruption among hospital staff has stronger negative effects on management quality and service outcomes. Our findings also show that corruption can distort the incentives and operational priorities within hospitals. Our work helps improve the understanding of the relationships between the ethical environment and hospital performance outcomes, offering insightful implications for better governance and policy settings in developing and transitional health systems.
papers.summary: 本研究探討了環境倫理（以區域醫療腐敗案件衡量）對醫院績效的影響。研究利用非醫療部門的腐敗案件作為區域醫療腐敗的工具變數，結合了世界管理調查的數據，涵蓋了2014年至2016年中國500多家醫院的營運與績效指標。結果顯示，區域腐敗案件增加三分之一會導致管理質量下降0.05個標準差，併發症率增加3%，住院時間延長0.15天。進一步分析發現，腐敗對年輕醫院的管理質量和年老醫院的績效結果負面影響尤為顯著，且醫院員工層級的腐敗比領導層腐敗對服務結果和管理質量的破壞力更強。
papers.significance: 本研究揭示了倫理環境與醫院績效之間的因果關係，證明了外部腐敗環境會扭曲醫院內部的激勵機制和營運優先順序，進而導致醫療結果惡化。其發現對於發展中及轉型期的醫療體系具有重要的政策啟示，有助於制定更精準的治理策略，特別是強調了需關注基層員工層級的倫理環境，以全面提升醫療服務品質與管理效率。

papers.title: Kids Give You Headaches? Universal Prekindergarten and Maternal Prescriptions for Pain-Relief and Hormone Medications.
papers.abstract: High-quality prekindergarten (pre-K) programs can promote school readiness and generate lifetime benefits. However, little is known about how pre-K programs affect mothers. We examine the effects of New York City's universal pre-K program (UPK) on the health of low-income mothers enrolled in Medicaid. We use a difference-in-regression-discontinuities approach that exploits the introduction of UPK and cutoffs for participation of children, to address potential confounders. We compare mothers of children born just inside the eligibility cutoff and mothers of those born just outside the eligibility cutoff, before and after the initiation of UPK. We find that the effects of UPK differ between single and non-single mothers, and that the effects also differ between mothers whose 4-year-old is the youngest child in the household and those with other, younger children at home. Specifically, the introduction of UPK was associated with significant reductions in use of non-addictive pain-relief drugs and in use of hormones (e.g., for birth control and menstrual disorders) among (single) mothers whose eligible children were the youngest in the household. While we do not find evidence of the effects of UPK on other types of utilization, these results reveal a new dimension on which UPK may affect maternal wellbeing.
papers.summary: 本研究利用雙重回歸斷點法，探討紐約市普及學前教育（UPK）計畫對參加醫療補助的低收入母親健康的影響。研究比較了子女出生日期在資格截止點前後的母親，發現UPK的效果因母親的婚姻狀態及家中有無更年幼子女而異。具體而言，對於家中符合資格的4歲子女為最小孩子的單身母親，UPK的實施顯著降低了其非成癮性止痛藥及激素藥物（如避孕藥或月經調節藥）的使用率。
papers.significance: 此研究拓展了對早期教育政策效益的認知，證實UPK不僅惠及兒童，還能透過減輕照顧負擔來改善單身母親的生理健康。研究結果揭示了公共政策在減輕女性壓力相關症狀和健康照護利用方面的潛在作用，為評估社會福利計畫的成本效益提供了關於母親福祉的重要證據。

papers.title: Pharmaceutical Pricing and R&D as a Global Public Good.
papers.abstract: This paper examines the international variation in the prices of branded pharmaceuticals. We consider short-run profits, or quasi-rents, as representing each country's contribution toward the global public good of therapeutic information embodied in new pharmaceuticals. We characterize globally optimal contributions through the Samuelson-Lindahl criteria and contrast the resulting outcomes with the Nash noncooperative equilibrium as developed in the Olson-Zeckhauser theory of international alliances. That theory predicts both the undersupply of public goods and the "exploitation" of large countries by small ones. We calculate national contributions to the global public good with data from a recent RAND report. Other countries' contributions resulting from their prices are much lower than those in the United States, but their free riding is not complete. We also find that country size is a powerful determinant of contributions and that larger countries contribute disproportionately more. Finally, we suggest a cooperative policy approach that would move us closer to optimality with health benefits for all countries.
papers.summary: 本文探討品牌藥品的國際價格差異，將短期利潤視為各國對全球公共產品（新藥治療資訊）的貢獻。研究利用薩繆爾森-林達爾準則與納什非合作均衡理論分析全球最適貢獻與現況，發現美國貢獻雖遠高於他國，但其他國家並非完全「搭便車」，且國家規模是決定貢獻度的關鍵因素。作者最終提出合作政策方案，以促進更接近最適狀態的全球健康效益。
papers.significance: 該研究將醫藥研發定義為全球公共產品，解釋了國際間藥價不平等背後的經濟邏輯，即大國補貼了全球研發。這為解決公共產品供給不足問題及設計國際合作定價機制提供了理論支持，有助於平衡各國負擔並優化全球醫療研發成果的分配。

papers.title: Walking With Feet Tied to the Past: Childhood Exposure to the 1918 Influenza Pandemic and Later-Life Male Mortality.
papers.abstract: Many previous studies have used cross-cohort comparisons and a focus on in utero exposure to document the lingering effects of the 1918 influenza pandemic on survivors' outcomes later in life. A subset has examined impacts on old-age health and mortality, finding mixed results. This paper contributes to the literature by extending the analysis to evaluate early-life and childhood exposure to the pandemic on old-age longevity along with a set of candidate mechanisms. We employ Social Security Administration death records linked to the full-count 1940 census and employ event-study and difference-in-difference regressions to compare longevity of cohorts with different age-at-exposure who were born in cities with high versus low exposure based on 1918 influenza-related mortality. Our treatment-on-treated calculations suggest that cohorts with age-at-exposure of 0-5 and 6-11 experience 7.2 and 10.9 months reductions in old age longevity; importantly, we note that these cohorts are often used as "controls" in the broader literature. While our main analysis focuses on males due to data constraints, supplementary results suggest similar effects for females. An analysis of census data suggests reductions in health, education and socioeconomic scores as potential mechanisms. The findings of this paper have important policy implications for interventions and identifying the populations at higher risks of adverse long-term outcomes during major pandemics.
papers.summary: 本研究利用1940年普查资料与社会保障局死亡记录，探讨1918年流感大流行期间童年暴露对老年长寿的影响。透过事件研究与双重差分模型分析，发现在高暴露城市中于0至11岁期间暴露的男性队列，其老年寿命显著缩短7.2至10.9个月。研究进一步指出，健康、教育及社会经济表现的下降是造成长期负面影响的关键机制。
papers.significance: 本文挑战了过往研究常将儿童期暴露队列视为「对照组」的做法，证实该群体同样受到大流行的严重长期冲击，从而有助于纠正相关计量偏误。其发现对公共政策具有重要启示，强调了在重大疫情期间识别高风险人群并进行早期干预，以预防长期健康与经济后果的必要性。

papers.title: Distinct Brain Systems Support Afferent and Efferent Autonomic Activity.
papers.abstract: Numerous studies have reported brain correlates of autonomic activity. However, ambiguity exists regarding whether those correlates reflect receiving or sending out autonomic signals. Additionally, little is known about how emotion and aging interact with brain-autonomic coordination. Based on time-varying heart rate variability (HRV) and blood oxygenation level dependent (BOLD) data (N = 104 younger; N = 51 older adults), we found insular and cingulate activity was negatively correlated with HRV during emotion regulation. We further examined the afferent and efferent nature of HRV-BOLD correlations during rest (N = 102 younger; N = 51 older adults). Functionally afferent regions where decreases in HRV were associated with subsequently increased BOLD activity included the posterior insula, postcentral gyrus and frontal pole. Functionally efferent regions where increased activity was associated with subsequently increased HRV included the anterior insula and cingulate. Information appeared to flow in one direction as the afferent regions' activity Granger-predicted the efferent regions' activity. Together, our findings suggest a feedback loop where decreased HRV increases the afferent regions' activity, which activates the efferent regions, leading to increased HRV. Aging seems to affect this system; the efferent and afferent regions scarcely overlapped for younger adults but did overlap for older adults.
papers.summary: 本研究探討了大腦與自主神經活動之間的關聯，區分了負責接收（傳入）和發送（傳出）自主神經訊號的大腦區域。通過分析心率變異性（HRV）與功能性磁振造影（BOLD）數據，研究人員發現島葉和扣帶皮層的活動與情緒調節期間的HRV呈負相關。進一步分析顯示，後島葉、中央後回和額極屬於功能傳入區域，而前島葉和扣帶皮層則屬於功能傳出區域。研究揭示了一個反饋迴路，即HRV降低會激活傳入區域，進而激活傳出區域以提高HRV。此外，老化似乎會影響此一系統，老年受試者的傳入與傳出大腦區域重疊度高於年輕人。
papers.significance: 這項研究釐清了大腦如何協調自主神經系統的傳入與傳出訊號，揭示了情緒調節和老化對大腦-自主神經連結的影響。通過識別特定的大腦區域及其資訊流向，研究結果增進了我們對生理反饋迴路的理解，特別是老化如何改變這種神經協調機制。這對於理解與年齡相關的自主神經功能障礙或情緒調節障礙具有重要的理論與臨床意義。

papers.title: Self-construal priming promotes prosocial risky behavior via reputation concern: A cognitive revaluation of decision weights and ERP correlates.
papers.abstract: How does temporarily activating an interdependent (vs. independent) self-construal shape costly decisions to benefit others? Using a within-culture, between-participants priming experiment, cognitive computational modeling, and event-related potentials (ERP), we examined the pathway from situationally activated self-construal to prosocial risky behavior (PRB). Interdependent (vs. independent) priming promoted PRB through heightened internalized reputation concern. Computationally, this was accompanied by lower sensitivity to self-gain and higher sensitivity to joint-gain, patterns consistent with reduced loss aversion and heightened guilt aversion, respectively. Neurally, interdependent priming was associated with a distinct ERP profile: smaller N1, larger N2, and smaller P3, compatible with attenuated early attentional capture, heightened conflict during value revaluation, and diminished cognitive effort during choice execution. These findings suggest that situationally activated self-construal can temporarily recalibrate decision weights and their neural correlates, offering one plausible pathway through which the self-concept shapes altruistic risk-taking. Because the design held a broader cultural context constant, the results isolate the effect of the primed self-schema and await cross-cultural replication.
papers.summary: 本研究透過啟動實驗、計算建模與事件相關電位（ERP）技術，探討情境啟動的相互依賴（相對於獨立）自我建構如何影響親社會風險行為。結果發現，相互依賴自我建構的啟動透過增強內化的聲譽關注促進了利他風險行為；計算上顯示受試者對自我收益敏感度降低、對共同收益敏感度提高；神經層面則表現為N1波幅縮小、N2波幅增大及P3波幅縮小，表明這種心理歷程涉及注意捕獲減弱、價值重估衝突增加及選擇執行認知努力降低。
papers.significance: 該研究的重要性在於揭示了自我建構不僅是穩定的文化特質，亦能被情境瞬時啟動並重校決策權重及其神經相關性。研究結合了心理學、神經科學與經濟學模型，為利他風險行為提供了認知重估的神經生物學證據，並闡明了聲譽關注在跨文化情境下驅動合作行為的關鍵路徑，對於理解人類社會決策的靈活機制具有重要貢獻。
